{"id":1936456792,"question_id":1666,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1772522745,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1936456792/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Make The String Great","memory":"8.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string makeGood(string s) {\n        stack<char>st;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i < s.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(!st.empty() and abs(st.top() - s[i]) == 32)\n            {\n                st.pop();\n            }\n            else st.push(s[i]);\n        }\n        \n        if(st.empty()) return \"\";\n\n        string ans =\"\";\n        while(!st.empty())\n        {\n            ans.push_back(st.top());\n            st.pop();\n        }   \n    reverse(ans.begin() , ans.end());\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"make-the-string-great","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1768}
